description: This file defines a class 'DateParts' that provides static methods to extract date components (day, month, year) from various date representations in a spreadsheet context. It includes methods for returning specific parts of dates, handling different input types, and managing compatibility with different Excel calendars.

classes.name: DateParts
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to extract day, month, and year parts from various date input formats in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Returns the day of the month (1-31) for a given date input, supporting arrays and different date formats.

methods.name: month
methods.description: Returns the month (1-12) of a given date input, considering Excel calendar types and array inputs.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Returns the year (e.g., 2023) for a given date input, supporting different formats and arrays.

methods.name: weirdCondition
methods.description: Handles special cases where date values are non-standard (e.g., 0 or boolean values) based on calendar and compatibility modes.
